description.en: Original columnar-jointing teaching outcrop: tightly adjoining irregular polygonal rock columns rooted in a continuous low rock mass, with uneven stepped broken ends. Cooling-contraction form concept, not a large-gap crystal cluster, precise locality, basalt-only claim or measured column diameter.
description.zh: 原创柱状节理教学岩体：紧接的不规则多边岩柱接入连续低岩体，不齐断端形成台阶。冷却收缩形态概念，非大空隙晶簇，不指定地点、只限玄武岩或实测柱径。
